summary: The registrant, BlackRock Private Credit Fund, filed an 8-K under Item 3.02 to report a routine private placement of unregistered Institutional Class shares totaling 896,142.303 shares for $21,080,761.92 consideration ($23.52 per share, at NAV), completed April 1, 2026 with finalization on April 20, 2026, sold to feeder vehicles via Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S exemption. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the filing also discloses NAV per share as of March 31, 2026 at $23.52 across all classes. This is a standard periodic capital raise and NAV update, not a special situation—no M&A, tender, restructuring, or activist campaign. There is nothing to watch or risk-arb angle.
